notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original full primary source unavailable after bounded open-access acquisition. Secondary original values in the replication authors’ workbook were not extracted as primary original evidence. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind extraction. Title, authors, year and DOI match the assigned original. The supplied frozen author-repository article text retains journal pagination but omits Table 1 (and the other displayed tables). Neither the requested zero-order r nor its associated p is recoverable from this text. Both are null; regression coefficients, indirect effects and omnibus p values describe different tests and were not substituted. The n is the explicitly reported complete-data final sample, not the initial recruited sample; no separate pairwise correlation n is available. No downloads or additional sources accessed. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 1 explicitly lists one test and its replication sample size. No arithmetic or recruitment-total substitution.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .20, corrected effect .20 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Explicit two-tailed p < .05 success definition and 100% success for exactly one test establish same-test bound. Exact p not supplied.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 100/100. Observed author summary mapped to successful; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
